subtitle: The most useful piece of theory in machine learning.

steps.label: TRAINING ERROR
steps.sub: How well it fits rows it has already seen

steps.label: GENERALIZATION
steps.sub: How well it performs on NEW rows -- the real goal

steps.label: BIAS (underfitting)
steps.sub: Too simple -- misses the pattern even with infinite data

steps.label: VARIANCE (overfitting)
steps.sub: Too flexible -- bends to follow the noise it happened to see

steps.label: NOISE IS IRREDUCIBLE
steps.sub: No model removes randomness in the data itself

steps.label: MORE FLEXIBILITY: LOWER BIAS, HIGHER VARIANCE
steps.sub: The best model balances the two
